messages:
marcos: FYI helm upgrade gpupool v2.0 -> v2.1 stuck in prod-usw2. Preflight hook job 'gpupool-preflight' Pending for ~12m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: release/gpupool-2.1 started; hook 'preflight' created job/gpupool-preflight (Pending).
lina: looked into the pod. describe shows: 
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age                From               Message
  ----     ------            ----               ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  12m (x3 over 12m)  default-scheduler  0/6 nodes are available: 6 node(s) didn't match node selector, 1 node(s) had taint {gpu:NoSchedule}.
```
ben: tl;dr: flux keeps reconciling the HelmRelease, and the gpupool CR instance still has the finalizer 'gpupool.redwood.io/cleanup' so failed hook pods aren't getting garbage-collected after retries. That blocks the job from finishing and keeps the release in limbo.
marcos: ah ok. autoscaler wouldn't spin up new nodes because the pod can't be scheduled to existing pools due to nodeSelector mismatch. We also have admission webhook that rejects new node labels unless validated by infra-team. :face_with_head_bandage:
lina: quick options: 1) pause Flux/Kustomization for the gpupool HelmRelease so hooks stop being reapplied; 2) patch gpupool CR's finalizers to allow cleanup; 3) manually create a temp nodepool with matching labels (costly).
ben: patch command I'm testing locally: `kubectl patch gpupool my-gpupool -n infra -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge` — removes finalizers so the failing cleanup can proceed. Use with care.
marcos: finance flag: creating a new 8xA100 nodepool in us-west-2 for immediate capacity is ~+$18k/mo. Not ideal unless customer SLA.
sre-oncall: I'll pause the Kustomization (usw2-gpupools) in flux for 15m and remove the finalizer, then re-run helm upgrade. Doing it now, ETA ~10m.
ops-bot: automation: paused Kustomization/usw2-gpools (by sre-oncall).
marcos: once paused, patch and re-run helm upgrade: `helm upgrade --install gpupool ./charts/gpupool --namespace infra --reuse-values` — watch for preflight job completion. If it still fails we'll rollback to 2.0 and open a maintenance window.
lina: noted. also adding a follow-up to infra backlog: make preflight hooks idempotent and tolerate pre-existing CRD finalizers + add a frontdoor preflight check in CI that simulates nodeSelectors.
ben: patch applied and hooks cleared on my side; no orphan pods now. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: patch complete, re-running helm upgrade now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: release/gpupool-2.1 hook preflight completed (Succeeded). Helm upgrade in progress.
marcos: nice. keep an eye on autoscaler and pod scheduling for the next 30m. I'll create a short postmortem thread with root cause and cost/ops mitigation suggestions.
ben: postmortem: create an Ops Runbook entry for gpupool upgrades (flux pause -> finalizer patch -> reapply) and link to this thread.
marcos: thanks team.
